reasoning_trace: Extracted the contamination section of base and head graders into modules; ran paired probes through check_value (container mode, default roots). Six heredoc probes (python3 - <<PY, bash <<EOF, cat <<EOF | bash, $(cat /root/secret) in an unquoted body, cat <<EOF > /home/operator/.ssh/authorized_keys, cat <<EOF | tee /home/operator/x) return outside_path on base and None on head; strip_heredocs removes the executed body and the opening line's redirect/pipe target before ABS_WORD runs at line 1412.
finding: Heredoc stripping removes code the agent executes and the heredoc's own redirect or pipe target, so outside-sandbox reads and writes through interpreter heredocs are graded clean
critique: The rule's premise (heredoc text is written data) holds only for writer commands; interpreters, eval/source, pipes and command substitution execute the body.
remediation: Re-emit the opening line (capture group), strip the body only when the receiving simple command is a writer with no pipe after the terminator word, always scan unquoted bodies for $( ` <(; add bats negative controls for each probe.

reasoning_trace: Probes cat /../root/.ssh/id_rsa and cat /./root/secret: base outside_path, head None. The exclusion runs before outside() normalises with os.path.normpath; ABS_WORD admits '.' as the first path char.
finding: The /. exclusion runs before normalisation, so /../ and /./ prefixed paths are never checked
critique: Validate-before-canonicalize ordering defect; a two-character prefix defeats the outside-path check.
remediation: n = os.path.normpath(w); exempt only when n == w and the first component is a genuine dot-directory; add bats case cat /../root/x expecting outside_path.

Probes cat /workspace/Hidden/tests.py, ls hidden, grep -ri hidden ., find / -name '*hidden*', find / -iname 'hidden': base hidden, head None. Read of /workspace/Hidden/x still flagged in head.

remediation: Scan strip_heredocs(val).lower() for 'hidden' first; run HIDDEN_TOKEN with re.I over the stripped bodies only; add bats cases for the five probes; fix header lines 166-168.

reasoning_trace: in_quotes (1372-1374) decides by quote parity over the whole prefix; after_closing_quote (1365-1369) accepts an empty quoted token. Probes cd "/root" && cat .ssh/id_rsa, cat ''/root/.ssh/id_rsa, echo "don't"; cd /root: base outside_path, head None. Review's example cat x>"/root/x" is still caught (> is a separator) — corrected here. Confidence medium because the comment at 1436-1437 records cd '/root/' as an accepted gap without a DEC.
finding: The two quote heuristics skip quoted and empty-quoted reads of sensitive roots, and a stray apostrophe earlier in the command flips every later sensitive word to quoted
critique: Parity counting is not shell tokenisation.
remediation: Use shlex.shlex(body, posix=True, punctuation_chars=True); exempt quoted sensitive words only as pattern arguments of grep/sed/awk; require a non-empty quoted token in after_closing_quote; add bats cases.

reasoning_trace: Timed strip_heredocs on 'cat <<EOF\n' + N lines with no terminator: 16 lines 0.016s, 18 0.067s, 20 0.287s, 22 1.209s (x4 per 2 lines). Runner calls the grader without timeout; watchdog_tick skips any job whose pipeline already has a final record; reap waits on the job pid; reap 1 at the end never returns. Companion dissent DISS-C-006 found the same regex independently.
finding: Exponential backtracking on an unterminated heredoc in agent-written transcript text, with no timeout around the grader in the runner, stalls the trial and the batch
critique: Nested lazy quantifier under re.S plus an unbounded external call in the batch's critical path.
remediation: Match the body as (?:[^\n]*\n)*? without re.S or use a line scanner; cap scanned length; wrap the grader and took-effect in timeout --kill-after=10 and row infrastructure_error on 124, or extend the watchdog over post-run; add a bats case with a 40-line unterminated heredoc.

finding: Any path word carrying = is dropped as a regex/key=value token
critique: The sed s=…=…= form is already covered by the ABS_WORD lookbehind on =.
remediation: Terminate the candidate at the first = (w.split('=',1)[0]) and keep it when still a two-component absolute path.

remediation: Skip only words matching a Loa slash-command/flag shape or sed/awk delimiter shape; otherwise keep as candidate; or extend the set; add bats cases.
